prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: production RGBA hair-card albedo texture for a realistic adult female ghost in a 3D horror game.
Primary request: one isolated straight vertical loose lock of wet near-black human hair, composed of many fine individual hairs gathered into about six uneven damp micro-clumps. Front orthographic flat texture, full length visible from dense root across the top to irregular fine tapered ends at the bottom. The lock fills most of a tall rectangular canvas, with small truly transparent margins on the sides. Root hairs continue off the top edge for seamless attachment to a scalp; the last fifth separates into extremely fine unequal ends with transparent gaps. Fine narrow transparent channels between some of the micro-clumps in the lower half. Natural slight irregular bends, no braiding and no curls. Fine detail must read at game distance, with subtle charcoal and neutral dark-brown variations. Soft even neutral diffuse illumination, no large baked white reflections, no cast shadow or 3D environment. This is the surface texture itself, not a photograph of an object lying on a surface.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background and gaps, no black/white background, no checkerboard painted into the image. No face, head, scalp, body, props, text, labels, border, watermarks, texture atlas panels, hands, hair tie or ponytail. One flat hair card only, straight vertical root-to-tip direction, photorealistic.
processing: Unmodified generated RGBA PNG1024x1536 retained in external source artifact; Sharp WebP quality92/alphaQuality100 encoding only, no resizing/crop/mask edit. Runtime card UV selects central area.
usage: Dedicated loose-hair material; original fitted scalp keeps the original long01 texture.
